title: exotic warm tunisian cobnuts tagine
description: a hearty, buttery, and chewy tunisian dish made with cobnuts, perfect for a lazy sunday

ingredients.name: cobnuts
ingredients.notes: you can also use hazelnuts or almonds

ingredients.name: double-rise bread
ingredients.notes: use a day-old bread for best results

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use a high-quality extra-virgin olive oil

ingredients.name: smoked paprika
ingredients.notes: use sweet or hot smoked paprika, depending on your preference

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: use a flaky sea salt or kosher salt

instructions: preheat your tandoor clay pot or a regular oven to 375f (190c).
in a large bowl, mix together the toasted and chopped cobnuts, torn bread, olive oil, nutritional yeast, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
transfer the mixture to the preheated tandoor clay pot or oven-safe dish.
cover the pot or dish with a lid or foil and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the bread is toasted and crispy.
remove the lid or foil and continue baking for another 5-10 minutes, or until the cobnuts are fragrant and lightly toasted.
serve warm, garnished with fresh herbs or a sprinkle of sumac, if desired.
